messages.subject: Postdoc in disease decisions at UVM
parts:
Hello all,
We're currently advertising for a postdoc at UVM to work on chronic wasting disease decision analysis with the State of Vermont and others. This postdoc will work with several USGS collaborators as well as be part of a team of postdocs working on disease decision problems across North America.

The position description is here, and applications are due May 15th. Please pass this along to interested folks.

Best,
Brittany

Brittany A. Mosher, Ph.D. (she/her/hers)
